assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes.
The potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis code R55.
The service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis code I25.10.
